speaker: (a man by the pillar)
text: With little riches. That is the word. Landed, yes. Rich, no. Some stones that may be ore, if a man likes his ore hopeful.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: With little riches. And who says so, that saw a man off the ship?

speaker: (a man by the pillar)
text: The court had it yesterday. Sunday. I have not had it from a sailor. Nobody here has.

speaker: (a clerk by the pillar)
text: A river as wide as a sea, they say, and a golden city one nation further up, and men whose heads grow beneath their shoulders. That last is from a man who had it from another man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the shoulders may wait. The landing I will keep. The gold I have already spent once this morning, at the stairs, and I am not spending it again.

speaker: george_bryan
text: You have it smaller already. I am not buying the tall one, and I am not rowing back for it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. The gold was spent at the stair. I came for paper.

speaker: michael_drayton
text: Will. Have you seen yourself in the Cambridge print? I looked along the leaf for my own name before I looked for yours. A man should confess the order.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I saw it on Thursday. I did not buy it. I have it by heart, which is cheaper.

speaker: michael_drayton
text: Of Raleigh, since the pillar will talk of nothing else. Eight months, and he comes home with a story.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's a living.

speaker: michael_drayton
text: Yours, or his?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: His, if the story holds. Mine, if I get my paper and go. A quire. What are you asking?

speaker: (the stall-keeper)
text: Fivepence the quire. Crown paper. I'll not cut it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fivepence. I'll take it whole.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Fivepence, and a blank book. That is a better purchase than a city you have not seen.

speaker: michael_drayton
text: Eight months at sea, and the city he did not find is already taller in the telling than the stones he brought. You are right not to buy the tall one. Write your own. You are late for somewhere.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Theatre, by ten. And a scarf, before I am looked at. God keep you, Michael.

speaker: michael_drayton
text: And you. Leave me the pillar. I have not yet found my own name, and I mean to be sure.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I am for the Theatre too. Navarre at two, and no ship in it. Do not be late on my account.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The phrase stays here. Little riches, and nobody off the ship.

speaker: (a man by the pillar)
text: Nobody. I have said so. The court had it yesterday, and the court did not send a sailor with it.

speaker: michael_drayton
text: Then write your own, if you must have a city. You are late for somewhere that pays you to be in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The quire is for a desk, not for a pillar. God keep you both.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Come, then. The hill is the same hill it was, and the scarf will not tie itself.
